about: C2PA Content Credentials for selected trentpower.fr media. A portable, asset-level provenance layer that complements the canonical PGP-signed integrity manifest. See https://trentpower.fr/ and docs/C2PA.md.

signer.note: Self-signed: binds a consistent claimed identity, not a trust-listed one. Public verifiers show the signer as untrusted. The PGP key is the identity anchor.

verify.tool: c2patool <file>, or the Content Authenticity Verify page
verify.also: Every listed file is recorded by hash in /integrity.json (the canonical proof).
